verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's first-party deferred-tools feature provides 'tools that require approval', which a user must approve first before the call proceeds. That covers requiring human approval for specific sensitive tool calls before they execute, and durable execution docs extend this to human-in-the-loop workflows. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of how per-tool or conditional (argument-based) approval rules are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval flow.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can require human approval before specific sensitive tool calls execute

citations.quote: Pydantic AI provides the concept of deferred tools, which come in two flavors documented below: tools that require approval, tools that are executed externally
